propositions: Code review must compile DiscoveryStagePlan units from immutable CriteriaSnapshot and execute through shared kernel, selecting each criterion exactly once per round while respecting effective disables and project applicability.
Positive authored usd_budget values must be enforced and shed over-budget units before calls; zero must be rejected by workflow validation.
When a local criterion call exhausts, retain earlier successes and continue independent criteria; blocking-capable missing coverage returns INDETERMINATE unless a real block exists.

Base-reviewer topology, model-ladder resolution, per-overlay context overrides, and absence of code-review checkpoints must be preserved; versioned discovery trace must persist internally without appearing in review response.

Shadow contract tests must detect mismatches between legacy and new projections, permitting only approved differences from effective disable/retune, project DET inclusion, applicability, budget enforcement, and partial-failure verdict policy.
